The left graph shows solar altitude changing with longitude, and below the highest point of the curve is labeled 60 degrees west longitude; the right graph shows noon solar altitude changing with latitude, and the highest point of the curve corresponds to 15 degrees south latitude. Reasoning: the question gives the coordinates of Buenos Aires as 33°S, 60°W. Therefore, at this time Buenos Aires may experience strong sunshine and clear brightness.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中的两幅曲线：左图最高点标在西经60度，右图最高点标在南纬15度。再读取题干中布宜诺斯艾利斯坐标为33°S、60°W。将其经度60°W与左图最高点对应，判断该地此时在正午前后；其纬度33°S距离右图太阳直射纬度15°S不远，正午太阳高度仍然很高。由“正午且太阳高度大”推出当地可能出现艳阳高照。
